text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Starting today, my trainee and I will be taking on the Twinkle Series. The Umamusume joining me for this journey is none other than…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wha? My dream? I dunno, I haven't really got one. I mean, I wanna try something new, and like, I don't wanna lose…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh, but I'll pass on anything difficult. It'd suck to chip my nails. So yeah, let's just take it easy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, <chrname> and I take our first steps towards competing in the Twinkle Series!
